title: Shared definitions
description: Building blocks shared by every Koshee Protect config schema. Change a definition here and every config type that uses it picks up the change.

configName.description: Config name. Decides the config type by prefix (detect_, dg_, ds_, otherwise camera/track) and where the server saves outputs. It may differ from the filename.

version.description: Incremented by +1 on the server on every save. Re-read the config after saving to learn the new value.

detectorEntry.description: One detector reference. Either points at another config (detect_*, dg_*, ds_*) or is an operator (exclusive, union, consensus) that combines a nested detectors list.

name.description: Optional human-readable label. May be empty.

detect.x-errorMessage: is not a valid detect value: use a config name starting with detect_, dg_ or ds_, or one of the operators exclusive, union, consensus
detect.description: Config to evaluate, or an operator. exclusive (the default when entries are listed without an operator) evaluates entries in order and uses the first that triggers; union evaluates all and merges results; consensus combines results by agreement.

detectors.description: Nested entries combined by the operator in detect. Required when detect is an operator.

time_start.description: Start of the active window (HH:MM:SS). Windows may cross midnight, e.g. 20:00:00 to 06:00:00.

days.description: Days of the week this entry is active.

timeOfDay.x-errorMessage: is not a valid time of day: use 24-hour HH:MM:SS, e.g. 20:00:00

localDateTime.x-errorMessage: is not a valid date-time: use YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS, e.g. 2024-09-27 19:59:58

calendarDate.x-errorMessage: is not a valid date: use YYYY-MM-DD

latLon.description: [latitude, longitude] in that order, as mapping software shows them. Note this is the reverse of GeoJSON's [lon, lat].

processes.description: Number of server worker processes of each kind.
